title.en: Simplify My Courses and keep courses platform-built
title.zh: 精简我的课程并统一使用平台内置课程

purpose.en: Make My Courses a direct list of the signed-in member's subscriptions and retire the former organization layer so every course remains created and maintained by the platform administrator.
purpose.zh: 让“我的课程”直接展示登录会员已订阅的课程，并退役原有组织层，使所有课程统一由平台管理员创建和维护。

en: Remove the duplicate My Courses subsection and large empty-state panel while preserving subscribed course cards and the Choose courses action.
Remove the former organization directory, management surfaces, supervisor packages, payout setup, and account or community entrances.
Keep card and crypto course purchases scoped directly to one platform-built language course without an intermediary organization or revenue split.
Keep historical database migrations intact while removing every active route, API, component, permission branch, and interface string for the retired module.
zh: 删除重复的“我的课程”子标题与大型空状态框，同时保留已订阅课程卡片和“选择课程”入口。
删除原有组织目录、管理页面、主管套餐、收款设置，以及账户和社区中的相关入口。
银行卡与加密课程付款直接绑定一门平台内置语言课程，不再经过中间组织或分成路径。
保留历史数据库迁移，同时移除退役模块的所有活动路由、API、组件、权限分支和界面文案。

en: My Courses, home, Community, Dashboard, account menu, membership panel, administrator dashboard, card checkout, course entitlement synchronization, classroom access, tutorial captions, and runtime layout validation.
zh: 我的课程、首页、社区、用户面板、账户菜单、会员面板、管理员面板、银行卡结账、课程权益同步、教室权限、新手教程字幕及运行时布局验证。

en: Render subscribed course cards immediately below the My Courses introduction and use a short unboxed message when there are no subscriptions.
Remove obsolete pages, APIs, UI components, helper libraries, translations, CSS, and layout routes for the retired organization product.
Remove intermediary identifiers from card checkout, webhook reconciliation, course purchases, enrollment, and private classroom authorization.
Update Community and the first-time tutorial to focus on people, clearly labeled AI classmates, rankings, and platform-built courses.
zh: 已订阅课程卡片直接显示在“我的课程”介绍之后；没有订阅时只显示简短、无外框提示。
移除退役组织产品的旧页面、API、界面组件、辅助库、翻译、CSS 和布局验证路由。
从银行卡结账、回调核对、课程购买、报名及专属教室权限中移除中间组织标识。
社区与新手教程改为聚焦真人、明确标注的 AI 学伴、排行榜和平台内置课程。

en: Passed the production build, strict TypeScript, zero-warning lint, all 400 site tests, 68-migration replay and idempotency, sensitive-data scanning, and every required shared portfolio policy check. Production browser regression follows the GitHub Actions to Cloudflare release.
zh: 已通过生产构建、严格 TypeScript、零警告 lint、全部 400 项站点测试、68 个迁移的重放与幂等检查、敏感数据扫描及所有必需的共享站点策略检查；GitHub Actions 发布到 Cloudflare 后继续执行生产环境浏览器回归。

en: Historical database tables and columns are intentionally preserved because deleting deployed data requires a separate reviewed data-retention decision.
zh: 历史数据库表和字段有意保留；删除已部署数据需要另行进行经过审查的数据保留决策。

en: Keep SmartLingo's twelve learning languages, Clerk identity, D1 data, Stripe, SmartPay3, wallets, and GitHub Actions to Cloudflare deployment isolated from every other site.
zh: 继续保持 SmartLingo 的十二种学习语言、Clerk 身份、D1 数据、Stripe、SmartPay3、钱包及 GitHub Actions 到 Cloudflare 发布流程与其他站点完全隔离。
